messages:
Mike H: noticing spike in 429s from several orgs since 07:12 UTC, rolling 1m 429/5xx up ~15%.
Sana R: I see it too, started right after the routing service deployment 07:09 — suspect v3 translation layer.
Devon L: Confirmed — logs show requests losing `X-Org-Id` header when routed through v3 translator. Example in access log: `method=POST path=/v1/outputs x-api-key=sk_prod_... x-route-version=v3 x-org-id=-`
OpsBot: [alert] 429_rate_high for org: org_482 (rate: 210/min)
Mike H: sample request headers I captured: `X-API-Key: sk_prod_...`, `X-Route-Version: v3`, missing `X-Org-Id`.
Sana R: That explains per-key quotas got evaluated against a missing org -> fallback to global per-org clamp which was zero for some customers -> immediate 429s.
Kerry: Which change could have removed the header? I can roll back the last routing deploy if needed.
Devon L: PR #3421 introduced header normalization in router v3 — it renamed `X-Org-Id` -> `X-Org` for internal consumers but forgot quota layer dependency.
Lucas M: Reproduced locally with curl: 
```
curl -v -H "X-API-Key: sk_prod_foo" -H "X-Route-Version: v3" https://proxy.internal/route
# response/tracing shows no X-Org-Id when it reaches quota service
```
Mike H: Quick mitigation idea: add a translation shim in router that maps `X-Org` back to `X-Org-Id` before quota enforcement. Less blast radius than rollback.
Sana R: Pushed hotfix branch `router-v3-restore-org` and created emergency PR #3433. Requesting canary deploy now.
OpsBot: deploy requested by Sana R: env=canary (10%) -> queued
Kerry: Can we avoid a full rollback? hotfix patch LGTM, let's canary first then promote if metrics look good.
Devon L: Canary applied to 10% routes, 429 drop from 18% -> 2% in metrics within 3m :thumbsup:
Mike H: Proceeding with 30% -> 100% over next 10 min. Watch traces and per-org tail latency.
OpsBot: deploy succeeded: router-v3-restore-org promoted to 100% @ 07:31 UTC
Sana R: Post-deploy metrics look clean, no more org-level 429 spikes across primary regions.
Lucas M: Root cause: a header rename in translation change without integration tests asserting `X-Org-Id` presence to quota service.
Kerry: Action items: 1) add unit/integration test to translation layer for `X-Org-Id` preservation 2) add a telemetry rule to alert if requests reach quota layer without an org header 3) update deploy checklist for header changes 4) postmortem.
Mike H: I'll own the postmortem. Draft in #postmortems by EOD, include timeline and mitigation steps.
Devon L: Filed INF-899 (tests for translation layer) and INF-900 (telemetry alert for missing org header).
Sana R: Good catch, thanks team. :pray:
Mike H: closing incident when postmortem posted.
OpsBot: incident closed by Mike H at 07:55 UTC
